description: Uploads local videos (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, MPEG, M4V) to a client site's video library in resumable parts, titled from their file names, for streaming playback without YouTube or Vimeo. Use it to host a hero video or a folder of clips; with showcaseId it also adds them to that showcase (and applies categories / categoryFromFolder), and for a projects showcase to the project you pass. Run with dryRun: true first; Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation. Re-running with the same arguments resumes interrupted uploads and skips finished ones. Returns files: each local path with its library video id.

categories.description: With showcaseId: categories to tag every video with, e.g. ["Tours"].

categoryFromFolder.description: With showcaseId: tag each video with its top-level folder name, e.g. true.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the user's project folder; relative paths resolve against it, e.g. "/Users/ana/sites/acme".

dryRun.description: Only check the files and report what would be uploaded, e.g. true for the first call.

paths.description: Files, folders, or glob patterns, e.g. ["/abs/photos/**/*.jpg"]. Prefer absolute paths; relative ones resolve against cwd.

project.description: With a projects showcase, and required there: the project (slug, title, or id) the videos join, e.g. "arched-entry-two-story".

recursive.description: Include subfolders (default true), e.g. false to upload only the top folder.

showcaseId.description: Showcase (in the same site) to add the videos to, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

siteId.description: Client site id from list_sites, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: upload_videos
title: Upload videos
